user.title: mobiDziennik
user.description: School address is the first part of the URL, e.g., for https://demo.mobidziennik.pl enter demo.

data.pulpit: Create a mobiDziennik dashboard (timetable, grades, tests, messages)

data_description.pulpit: The dashboard appears in the sidebar shortly after setup (refresh the page if needed). You can also add the „mobiDziennik” card to any dashboard.

init.title: Settings
init.description: Choose the modules you need – unchecked ones are not downloaded and their entities are removed.

data_description.podpisy: E.g. “Jan Kowalski, Anna Kowalska”. Used at the end of the excuse note. Empty = name from the mobiDziennik account.
data_description.plec: Used in the excuse note text.

przygotuj_usprawiedliwienie.name: Prepare excuse note
przygotuj_usprawiedliwienie.description: Checks detailed attendance and prepares an excuse note for unexcused absences and late arrivals. Sends nothing.

zakres.name: Range
zakres.description: tydzien = last finished week, wszystkie = since the start of the school year.

wyslij_usprawiedliwienie.name: Send excuse note
wyslij_usprawiedliwienie.description: Sends the prepared excuse note to the class tutor as a mobiDziennik message.

podpis.name: Signature
podpis.description: Parent name at the end of the message.

odrzuc_usprawiedliwienie.name: Discard excuse note
odrzuc_usprawiedliwienie.description: Deletes the prepared, unsent excuse note.
